subject: Renewal QBR — scheduling: compressed demo window vs multi-day coverage
messages:
From: Natalie Brooks <natalie@harborhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Timothy Grant <tim.grant@harborhealth.com>
Date: Thu, May 2, 2028 at 9:12 AM PDT
Subject: Redwood Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling

Hi Jordan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the note — we’re approaching renewal for a number of HarborHealth services and our leadership wants a concise QBR plus a technical roadmap demo that shows the 2028 performance/latency improvements and the Dedicated offering. A few constraints from our side:
- Execs prefer a single hour if possible (tight calendar) but our infra/ML leads want 90 minutes for the demo + Q&A.
- Procurement (cc’d Tim) needs to see an SOW/term summary before finaling dates.
- We’re on Pacific time; best windows are mornings.

Can you propose a couple of concrete options next week? We can do either:
A) One 90-minute session (preferred by product/infra) — 10:00–11:30 PT on Tue/Wed/Thu
B) Two shorter blocks across two days (60 + 30 min) to split exec overview and deep technical walkthrough

I attached our prework (HarborHealth-prework.pdf) with stakeholder names and priorities.

Thanks — looking to lock this in by EOD Monday if possible.

—Natalie
Natalie Brooks
Head of Platform Integrations, HarborHealth
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Brooks <natalie@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, May 2, 2028 at 11:05 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Redwood Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling

Hi Natalie — thanks for the clear constraints and the prework. Quick read-through — that helps.

We can do either A or B. To balance exec availability with the technical depth your engineers want, I’m proposing a fallback plan that minimizes rework:
- Primary: Tue, May 4, 2028 10:00–11:30 PT (90 min) — full QBR + roadmap demo + 20 min deep Q&A.
- Fallback compressed: Wed, May 5, 10:00–11:00 PT (60 min) — 40 min demo + 20 min prioritized Q&A (exec focus).
- Two-part option: Mon/Tue split — Mon 30-min exec overview (9:30–10:00), Tue 60-min technical deep dive (10:00–11:00).

I attached a draft agenda (QBR_agenda_v2.pdf) and a short CSV of the customer questions we plan to cover (customer-questions.csv). If procurement needs a term summary now, Karthik is listed here to coordinate — Karthik, can you confirm whether we should share the standard renewal SOW or the custom term sheet for HarborHealth?

Logistics/ops: Marissa — can you confirm availability of a dedicated demo environment for the 90-min slot? If not, we’ll need to compress and focus on highlights.

If we can get confirmation by EOD Monday (May 3) I’ll send a calendar invite and DocuSign SOW link for signature.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
From: Natalie Brooks <natalie@harborhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Timothy Grant <tim.grant@harborhealth.com>
Date: Fri, May 3, 2028 at 7:48 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Redwood Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling

Jordan — thanks, that looks good. Quick update from our side after talking to execs and procurement:
- Execs will not give 90 minutes next week; the best single slot they’ll approve is 60 minutes.
- Procurement (Tim) says they can review the SOW this week but want the signed term sheet before the renewal call if there are pricing concessions.

We’d like to try the compressed path on:
- Tue, May 4, 2028 10:00–11:00 PT (we can extend +15 if necessary).

Tim — can you confirm whether you’ll sign via DocuSign if we send the same standard SOW with the renewal addendum?

I’ll accept the calendar invite once I see the event and agenda.

—Natalie
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Brooks <natalie@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, May 4, 2028 at 4:45 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Redwood Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — scheduling

Thanks Natalie — confirmed for Tue, May 4, 2028 10:00–11:00 PT (compressed). I’ve created the calendar event and included a short pre-read. Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def

Actions:
- Marissa: please prepare the demo environment with the 2.0 latency profiles and the Dedicated capacity example; plan for a 40-minute demo that hits the three priority items in HarborHealth-prework. If we can’t run the full Dedicated handoff live, have a recorded clip ready.
- Karthik: procurement asked about any one-time credits; please confirm whether we can authorize up to $10k one-time credit for early renewal. We need approval before sending the DocuSign envelope.
- Natalie/Tim: I’ll send the DocuSign link for the standard SOW with the renewal addendum; if you can sign the envelope before the call it would make the conversation much smoother: https://www.docusign.com/recipient?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d

Attachments: QBR_agenda_v2.pdf, customer-questions.csv

If anything changes on your side, please flag the calendar event — otherwise I’ll assume Tue morning is locked and will prepare a 60->75 minute contingency.

Best — Jordan
